definition: a counterparty that can be handed to someone else without my consent

settled:
I never picked the company that services my mortgage. Whoever wrote the loan sold the paper on, and the buyer became my counterparty with no part of the choice mine.

Any product whose relationship can be sold to a third party behind my back works the same way.

My grade on one of those records the concern rather than naming anything I decided.

The leaning runs the other way there too. They need my payments more than I need them in particular, and a swap of servicer is routine.

title: The Dependencies I Did Not Choose
